name: The Night Watch
summary: In eastern Raven Hill, The Night Watch calls on outsiders to enter the crypts. Commander Althea Ebonlocke sends them to destroy the plague spreaders while her guards defend Darkshire. This is the final mission in the town guard’s direct campaign against the undead overrun.

sections.title: A Desperate Frontier
sections.body: Darkshire stands nearly alone, abandoned by Stormwind’s military and reliant on its civilian militia, The Night Watch. Commander Althea Ebonlocke has spent her limited manpower guarding the crossroads, town perimeter, and supply lines. As the restless dead multiply across Duskwood, she turns to wandering champions to carry the fight into Raven Hill’s shadowed depths.

sections.title: Purging the Mausoleum
sections.body: The eastern mausoleum in Raven Hill Cemetery holds one of the region’s most dangerous concentrations of undead, unlike the open barrows. Its stone crypt teems with plague spreaders, ghouls whose afflictions can sicken the living. Destroying twenty gives The Night Watch room to breathe and helps keep Darkshire from facing a coordinated undead surge from the west.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch sending adventurers instead of their own men?
aliases: why the night watch needs help
faq.answer: The Night Watch is stretched thin across Duskwood. With Stormwind sending no official troops, Commander Althea Ebonlocke has barely enough guards to hold Darkshire’s perimeter and watch the roads. No spare militia can enter fortified crypts like Raven Hill.

faq.q: Where is the eastern mausoleum located?
faq.answer: The eastern mausoleum lies in the eastern part of Raven Hill Cemetery, in northwestern Duskwood. Its entrance leads underground to stone crypts where plague spreaders gather.

faq.q: What makes the plague spreaders dangerous?
faq.answer: Plague spreaders are ravenous ghouls carrying virulent decay. Their corruption threatens to spread beyond the cemetery and taint Darkshire’s surviving residents.
Althea Ebonlocke commands The Night Watch and is related to Darkshire’s mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke. She organizes Duskwood’s defense from inside Darkshire.

faq.q: Does completing this chain end the undead threat in Duskwood?
faq.answer: No. Thinning the mausoleum’s ranks eases the immediate pressure on Darkshire, but Raven Hill remains infested, and darker powers across Duskwood still stir the dead.

faq.q: How does this fit into the Night Watch questline?
aliases: is this the last night watch quest
faq.answer: This is the third and final chapter in Commander Ebonlocke’s direct martial series for The Night Watch. The campaign moves from the open roads to the graveyard outskirts, then deep into the mausoleum.

angles.text: With Stormwind’s crown ignoring Duskwood’s pleas, Alliance champions must step forward to save loyal citizens from the undead.
As a paladin, you face an unholy mockery of sacred burial rites in Raven Hill’s plague-ridden vaults. Cleansing its crypts is a vital duty to the Holy Light.
As a priest, you face the vile contagion spread by the ghouls in the eastern mausoleum. The threat calls for cleansing in spirit and body.
